role: E256 evidence-ladder and open-finding receipt playback

answers.question: What does the audit ladder actually contain, and what does it still not close?
answers.answer: Four independent implementations agree on one fixture, with a five-check formal certificate and 49 publication-guard checks at zero failures. The optimizer verdict is a bounded failure, human review is pending, and E256-003 stays open.

reproduce.behavior: Renders deterministic playback of a preserved receipt. It runs no benchmark, no test suite, no synthesis, and no cracking run.
reproduce.workspacePathConstraint: The tape records to an absolute path under /Volumes/Code/MuleinLabs and must be adjusted if the workspace is relocated.

capturedAtBasis: Rendered during this documentation pass; the underlying experiment predates it and is dated in the receipt itself

captureMethod.mode: normal-speed playback of a preserved receipt

artifacts.kind: durable byte-for-byte copy used by the tape

ladder.yosysParity: 8/8 full-adder rows; 16 counter transitions; 1024 toy-ISA transitions

checks: plugboard and XOR-center involutions plus fixed-point law

experiment.optimizerInterpretation: bounded optimizer failure; not security evidence or a work-factor estimate

timingContext.interpretation: The capture replays preserved text at normal speed. Any elapsed-time figures visible on screen are historical observations from the original run on one Apple-silicon host, not fresh measurements and not portable performance contracts.

claimBoundaries: This is playback of a preserved validation receipt, not a live run.
Four agreeing implementations is a parity result, not a security result.
The optimizer outcome is a bounded failure and is labelled in the file as not security evidence.
Human review is pending and audit finding E256-003 remains OPEN.
The v1 autopsy figures narrated in this episode are not printed by this receipt and are not shown on screen.
The 49-check publication guard suite is a different suite from the 47-test canonical Swift suite in the same file.
